name: Digital twin: assimilation, consistency, drift detection and recalibration, forecast
description: A state-space model and a data source (a simulated plant with a known parameter drift, a CSV replay or a live stream); an ensemble Kalman filter of the states and slow parameters; NIS and NEES against their chi-square bands; anomaly flags; CUSUM drift detection with recalibration through the inverse workflow; a forecast with intervals, what-if runs and a dashboard (pinneapple_systems.digital_twin.workflow).

params.title: Digital twin: assimilation, consistency, drift detection and recalibration, forecast
